workflow: A formatting adapter converts formatter output into mutable text storage.
The adapter assumes the resulting text is nonempty and ends with a line terminator.
Formatter output is empty or omits the expected terminator.
The adapter indexes the final position and writes a terminator without validating the length or suffix.
Empty output causes a write before the allocated buffer, producing a heap-buffer-overflow; unterminated output may also be truncated incorrectly.
summary: Unchecked trailing-terminator removal causes boundary heap write
decision_reason: This is distinct from the existing clusters: the failure is an unconditional final-byte write based on an unverified nonempty, terminated string, not a matching read, conversion, lifetime, concurrency, or generic buffer-capacity workflow.
